extraction.Name: Louis Mosseau
extraction.Tribe/Reservation: Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee to his 160 acre allotment when it was issued, in September, 1919, but he was informed by the Indian Agency that, if he did not accept the patent, it would be taxed, and finally sold for taxes, so he took it
extraction.Buyer: William Losey, of Allen, South Dakota, for $1600.00 cash
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: he was informed by the Indian Agency that, if he did not accept the patent, it would be taxed, and finally sold for taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: farms his wife's land and works for other farmers, this constituting his only income
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, has good health; has a wife whose health is poor, being bothered with appendicitis; has four children to support with pretty good health; he considers $1600.00 was a poor price for the allotment, as land was a good price at that time; has never received any aid from the County, State nor the United States Government; document sworn December 11, 1928; 160 acre allotment
